name: Elune's Grace
summary: Night elf priests leave Dolanaar for Darnassus to receive Elune's Grace. The rite marks their readiness for a divine talent reserved for the kaldorei.

sections.title: A Sacred Milestone
sections.body: A priest of the Sisterhood of Elune needs more than skill in prayers of mending and smiting. With experience, an acolyte reaches the point where blessings reserved for the kaldorei may be bestowed. Local mentors such as Laurna Morninglight in Dolanaar cannot teach these deeper arts, so they send promising disciples to the spiritual heart of their order.

sections.title: Audience at the Temple
sections.body: Initiates cross Teldrassil to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. There, beneath the gaze of the high priesthood, Priestess Alathea judges whether each petitioner is ready to bear the goddess's defensive mantle. She teaches Elune's Grace there, a divine talent reserved for the kaldorei.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: Night elf priests return to Darnassus for a rite of passage when they have gained enough practical experience. At the Temple of the Moon, Priestess Alathea tests them and teaches the defensive art of Elune's Grace.

Priestess Alathea is a high-ranking priest trainer at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. She oversees the formal training and advancement of night elf acolytes, judging whether they have the spiritual focus for advanced racial prayers.

faq.q: Why can't local mentors teach this ability?
faq.answer: Outpost mentors such as Laurna Morninglight guide novices through foundational teachings, but the Sisterhood reserves sacred blessings unique to the kaldorei for formal conferral. Acolytes travel to the order's central seat of devotion in Darnassus for evaluation before learning these deeper gifts.

faq.q: What does Elune's Grace actually represent in kaldorei faith?
faq.answer: Elune's Grace represents the Moon Goddess's direct protection. Woven through prayer, it diminishes the force of incoming attacks and reflects Elune's sheltering presence over her faithful when danger draws close.

faq.q: Can priests of other races receive this blessing?
aliases: is elunes grace night elf only
faq.answer: No. Elune's Grace belongs to the ancestral faith and worship of the kaldorei. Only night elf priests who commune directly with the Moon Goddess are taught its invocation.

faq.q: Where does this journey begin and end?
faq.answer: Laurna Morninglight sends the acolyte from Dolanaar on Teldrassil to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

angles.text: As a night elf priest, you learn the Sisterhood of Elune's celestial magic, distinct from universal holy practices.
As a night elf, your pilgrimage to the Temple of the Moon reflects Elune's central place in kaldorei society. It brings distant acolytes to the heart of Darnassus.
